_doc: Q1 (tapped-line timer, real drives on the tg15p hop) + Q3 N-spread. All MEASURED, SG13G2/PSP103 tt, committed instrument (swsweep harness text-patched). Acceptance pre-registered in PRE_REGISTERED.json.

temperature_plumbing.OPTIONS_DEVICE_TEMP: INERT (byte-identical zeros 0/27/85C, all .so TR=27) -- REFUTED as a corner mechanism
temperature_plumbing.instance_dta_via_shim_GDTA: WORKS (Id 321.7->305.0 uA at +58K); shim must not define .param GDTA itself (local def shadows deck's)

timer_design_v2.cells: trigger inv_1+inv_2; N x inv_1 line + CTRIM cap-DAC (2 nodes); nand2_1 pulse gate; gtp tap inv_1+inv_4 (pMOS cut ~21 ps EARLY, harmless); gt tap inv_1+inv_1+inv_2 (nMOS cut LAST, tuned to the zero); pk tap 7 x inv_1 (lands ~36 ps after the cut)
timer_design_v2.v1_failures_recorded: single-tap order (nMOS first) let the LC ring to -70 uA through the still-on pMOS -> VBEND 0.651 FAIL; fanout<1 drivers burned 508 fJ
timer_design_v2.achievable_widths: odd multiples of the stage delay only; CTRIM covers the gap

tuned_row_27C_n7_c25.note_effective_cut: ~0 uA at the 80% gate point where the nMOS stops conducting
tuned_row_27C_n7_c25.completeness: BOTH PASS (VBEND +1.3% of ideal 0.6759; VA drained)
tuned_row_27C_n7_c25.vs_tg60_ring_robust_anchor: 8.11 vs 10.69 fJ = -24%: the tg15p win SURVIVES real edges

injection_caveat_fC.meaning: real drives inject ~3.3 fC into bank B via TG parasitics (booked in E_timer, so no free lunch); +1.3% VBEND and part of the -3.3% E_hop is timer subsidy

admission.verdict: the hybrid as built (stdcells, 1.5V) is WORSE than the refuted ZCD on per-bank energy; it wins on mechanism (no per-hop comparator, detector amortizes) and has ~5.5x of stdcell tax between 302.8 and the 55 fJ gate-charge floor

park_edge_effect.A_side_ring: V(bka) pk-pk 0.29 -> 0.71 V, I(L) ring +/-50 -> +/-120 uA (real edges double the corpse-side ring)
park_edge_effect.B_side: V(bkb) ripple after park 2.1 mV (vs 47 mV post-open excursion ideal) -- the delivered rail is quiet

tracking.verdict: REPLICA FAILS IN MAGNITUDE (pre-registered expectation confirmed): the line is RC-governed, the zero LC-governed. SIGN saves it: heat lengthens the width (late = benign, ~+24 ps at 85C ~ -7% E_hop, VBEND fine), cold shortens it (early = bad, ~-14 ps at 0C ~ -1.8% VBEND ~ -12 mV/hop against the ~120 mV chain budget).
tracking.cadence: to hold the +-7.5 ps measured-benign residual the die may drift +-16K between calibrations; +-33K for the +-15 ps pre-registered band. Thermal drift is ms-scale vs ~600 ps hops -> calibration every ~1e6+ hops suffices; the line does NOT track the zero, the SAR loop must.

n_spread.config: dV=0.8 committed zcs unit, parallel-copy scaling, switch held ON, TON=10ps uniform (offset vs committed 2ps N=8 rows: -2.65 ps uniform)
n_spread.verdict: 1/sqrt(N) HOLDS for random data; FULL-SCALE spread is N-INVARIANT (~17-18%) -- worst-case data does not average, the shared-timer budget must charge +-32 ps OR the architecture must guarantee near-random data (+-3 sigma at N=128 is +-5.8 ps)
n_spread.placement_independence: 3 permutations at k=N/2 byte-identical at every N; t(a) one N-invariant curve (max 2.4 ps deviation)
